subject: Security intake: compact SOC 2 + DPA review — evening availability?
messages:
From: Alex Porter <alex.porter@bluetile.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: security@bluetile.com
Date: Fri, 16 Aug 2029 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Brief intake: can we compress SOC 2 / DPA review into one evening slot?

Hi Tessa,

Were finalizing our procurement timeline and wondered whether Redwood can run a condensed security walkthrough covering SOC 2 controls overview + DPA touchpoints in a single evening session (60-75 minutes). Our security folks are tight on weekdays — evenings (US EDT after 6pm) work best.

High-level asks:
- SOC 2 controls summary and where logs/evidence live
- DPA specifics around retention and deletion flows
- Pen-test scope expectations (do you allow customer-submitted vendor tests?)

Do you have a 60-75 minute evening window in the next two weeks? If you prefer, we can do a two-part (45 + 30) split.

I attached our internal evidence checklist for reference.

Thanks,
Alex Porter
BlueTile Capital — InfoSec
Attachment: BlueTile_Evidence_Checklist.pdf (pdf, 210KB)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Porter <alex.porter@bluetile.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Aug 2029 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Brief intake: can we compress SOC 2 / DPA review into one evening slot?

Hi Alex — thanks for the checklist, and good timing. We can do a compact session; our recommended format for a single-evening delivery is: 60 minutes focused (30m infra + logs/evidence map, 20m DPA + dataflow, 10m Q&A), with a 30-minute ops bridge available immediately after for any live evidence handoffs.

Availability from our side (US EDT preferred):
- Tue Aug 20, 6:30pm–7:45pm EDT
- Thu Aug 22, 7:00pm–8:15pm EDT
- Mon Aug 26, 6:00pm–7:15pm EDT (last-resort)

If those dont work we can offer an APAC-friendly early-morning slot and loop in our pen-test vendor policy owner. Also: can you confirm the attendee list (names + roles) and whether the vendor will require a temporary SFTP link for evidence transfer?

Ill put a tentative hold on Tue/Thu for now.

—Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | developer-first inference runtime
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Alex Porter <alex.porter@bluetile.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Aug 2029 17:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Brief intake: can we compress SOC 2 / DPA review into one evening slot?

Adding ops notes — we can staff the 60/30 flow (ops bridge then dry-handoff) on Tue Aug 20. Bridge will be on our standard conference bridge; Ill attach the .ics once Alex confirms final time. For pen-test policy: we accept customer-initiated vendor tests but require a short intake form + proof that the vendor will follow our allowed tools list. Kimberly, can you drop the policy pointer here?

Ben
Ben Carter
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
Attachment: ops-bridge-invite.ics (ics)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Alex Porter <alex.porter@bluetile.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Aug 2029 20:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Brief intake: can we compress SOC 2 / DPA review into one evening slot?

Thanks Ben — quick policy note for Alex: yes, customer-submitted pen tests are supported. We ask for:
- Completed vendor intake (link below)
- High-level test plan (targets & dates)
- Notification window for our infra teams (minimum 48 hours)

If youd prefer not to run pen tests during the walkthrough, we can signpost where to run them and schedule a separate validation window.

Vendor intake form: https://redwood-secure.example.com/vendor-intake

If Tue Aug 20 at 6:30pm EDT works for you, Alex, well mark the hold firm and send the calendar invite with the ops bridge.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Trust, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Porter <alex.porter@bluetile.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: security@bluetile.com, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Aug 2029 09:40:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Brief intake: can we compress SOC 2 / DPA review into one evening slot?

Hi Tessa/Kimberly/Ben — Tue Aug 20 at 6:30pm EDT works for our team (Alex Porter, Emily Huang - Security, Naveen Singh - Legal). Well hold that time. We do intend to run a vendor-led pen test later in the quarter; for this briefing well just discuss scope and policy.

I attached the evidence checklist as you requested earlier (same file) and Ill complete your vendor intake link for the later pen test. Please send the calendar invite and ops bridge details and well distribute to our attendees.

Thanks — see you Tue evening.
Alex
